pokedexEntries.ru: SHIFTRY is a mysterious POKéMON that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years. It creates terrific windstorms with the fans it holds.

pokedexEntries.sa: SHIFTRY’s large fans generate awesome gusts of wind at a speed close to 100 feet per second. The whipped-up wind blows anything away. This POKéMON chooses to live quietly deep in forests.

pokedexEntries.frlg: A POKéMON that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe’s mind and take preemptive action.

pokedexEntries.em: It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds. Feared from long ago as the guardian of forests, this POKéMON lives in a deep forest where people do not venture.

pokedexEntries.dpp: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

pokedexEntries.vi: Legends tell of a bird Pokémon that received divine punishment for its evil deeds and had its beak and wings replaced.
